capture.original_context: Interval notes. A perfect fifth spans seven semitones, for example D to A. A perfect fourth spans five semitones, for example C to F. The fifth and the fourth add up to an octave. An octave spans twelve semitones. A tritone spans six semitones. A perfect fifth is stable. Every interval can be inverted. In a choir, a perfect fifth is stable.
capture.original_input: How many semitones are in a fourth, a fifth and a tritone?
